title: Fix F6: atomic, claim-first installment payment and payment-agreement verification
statusReason: Statically verified (syntax, 24 static tests at the time, boundary scan, two mutation tests). The six installment DB tests could not run (no Postgres here). The agreement-verify path has no DB test at all because finance_invoices and finance_payment_agreements are not in the isolated schema. PASS requires the Replit run, and a staging check of the verify flow.

commit.workingTree: Uncommitted; bound by content via fin-provenance-manifest.json.

behaviorChanges: PUT /finance/amortization/:id/pay: payAmortizationInstallment runs claim (UPDATE ... WHERE status <> 'paid'), principal and interest repayment rows, the entry balance+status (one statement) and interest paid in ONE transaction. A repeat or concurrent request for a paid installment returns it unchanged (same as the old early return) without writing again. Previously two concurrent requests could both record repayments.

POST /finance/payment-agreements/:id/verify: one transaction that first claims the agreement (status must still be passkey_confirmed), then posts the repayment, applies the balance change, and updates invoice paidAmount and status in one statement. A concurrent or repeated verification returns 409 instead of double-posting. Invoice status now comes from the database's current amount, not the value read at request start.
Journal postings, notifications and invoice events remain best-effort after commit.

mutation: write outside the transaction in the installment route (copy)
commands.result: ratchet and F6 gate fail as intended
